items.question: Four kids can wash three whiteboards in 20 minutes. How long would it take, in minutes, for one kid to wash six whiteboards?

items.question: In the last 25 years, 60% of Scrabble champions have been women and the rest have been men. There is one champion per year. Of the men, 40% had a beard. How many men with beards have been Scrabble champion?
In a forest, there are three anthills. In the first anthill, there are 100 ants, and in each next anthill, there are 20% fewer ants than in the previous one. How many ants are in the third anthill?
